sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Measured Strike
sourceMenuOrBranches.activation: Within one actual weapon attack, before its attack roll
sourceMenuOrBranches.procedure: Roll the spentd6 and add it to that one attack roll. Choose before seeing the d20/outcome; natural1 still misses and no extra critical range is created. It adds no damage and supplies no attack, target permission or extra Action.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Driving Shove
sourceMenuOrBranches.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary Shove
sourceMenuOrBranches.cost: One superiorityd6 plus the replaced attack
sourceMenuOrBranches.procedure: Before both opposed rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to yourSTR Athletics total for that one ordinary Shove. Target choosesAthletics/Acrobatics; tie preserves state. Actual reach/one-size-larger cap applies; success still pushes5ft away OR Prone, never both solely from this maneuver. It adds no damage.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Disarming Feint
sourceMenuOrBranches.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary opposed Disarm
sourceMenuOrBranches.procedure: Choose a reachable actually held droppable item and an ordinary legal Athletics or weapon-check Disarm. Before rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to your one opposed total; defender usesAthletics/Acrobatics, tie preserves state. Success uses the existing adjacent/own-space drop placement, not automatic custody. No damage, severed bond or proficiency grant. The save-based Disarm feat and Whip Control are separate procedures and do not acquire this bonus.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Guarding Deflection
sourceMenuOrBranches.activation: Reaction when one direct damage event would damage you
sourceMenuOrBranches.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Reaction
sourceMenuOrBranches.procedure: After passive defenses but before tempHP, spend/roll1d6 to reduce that whole resolved event by its face, minimum0. Allocate across stable native component order. Attached conditions remain. No re-mitigation of transfer packets that forbid recipient mitigation, HP sacrifice, state assignment or direct death. It neither changes a hit to a miss nor qualifies as Riposte's successful Parry.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Measured Advance
sourceMenuOrBranches.activation: Bonus Action on your own regular turn
sourceMenuOrBranches.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual BA
sourceMenuOrBranches.procedure: Spend/roll1d6, gaining a separate movement-cost budget of5×face feet resolved immediately. Use one already available movement mode with nonzeroSpeed, pay normal terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, respect legal endpoints and provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. No teleport, new movement mode, free Disengage, replenished ordinary movement or banked distance. Interrupted unspent distance is lost.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Rallying Signal
sourceMenuOrBranches.activation: Action under the ordinary Rally procedure
sourceMenuOrBranches.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Action
sourceMenuOrBranches.procedure: Choose one actual ally within30ft able to perceive the rally and one active source-qualifiedFrightened record. Before rolling the ordinaryCHA task check at its sourceDC (otherwise10), spend/roll thed6 and add its face to the total. Apply actual task degrees/natural shift; success ends only that selected record. NoHP/tempHP, loyalty, extra save, new ally turn or automatic cure of other fear records.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Ground companion
sourceMenuOrBranches.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small or Medium terrestrial Beast with ordinary biting anatomy; preserve its actual size. Dog/fox-like examples are illustrative, not free supplied animals.
sourceMenuOrBranches.attack: One melee bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d6piercing; no addedWIS damage and no automatic level scaling.
sourceMenuOrBranches.sense: Choose its actually sourced keen hearing OR smell, if present, for advantage on that sense's actual Perception checks. No new keen sense if absent.
sourceMenuOrBranches.limits: No Pack Tactics, knockdown, grapple, multiattack, burrow or extraordinary source powers. Carrying uses this actual body/STR and ordinary Load/pounds limits, real harness/hands. A mount must separately meet real riding eligibility.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Flying companion
sourceMenuOrBranches.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Tiny winged Beast that already possesses natural flight and a pecking/biting attack. No Hover.
sourceMenuOrBranches.attack: One melee peck/bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d4piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.
sourceMenuOrBranches.sense: Retain actual sourced keen sight, if present, as advantage on that sense's Perception checks; no automatic darkvision/blindsight.
sourceMenuOrBranches.limits: No free Flyby, invisibility, aerial carrying exception, Hover, multiattack or ability to carry a Medium ally. Ordinary falling, weather, carrying and support apply.

sourceMenuOrBranches.name: Swimming companion
sourceMenuOrBranches.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small Beast with native swimming and biting anatomy. Keep its real breathing requirements; a fish gains no lungs and an air breather gains no gills.
sourceMenuOrBranches.attack: One melee bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d6piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.

sourceMenuOrBranches.limits: The5ft ground movement is crawling/flopping for a body without legs, paying ordinary crawl cost and suffocation/exposure; no new hands, amphibiousness, Water Breathing, multiattack or sonar.
